title: A problem with finow-q1-pro watch for dexcomg6
body:
Hello there
I am using a finow-q1-pro watch as a collector for my daughter's dexcomg6 with two followers the 1st is Huawei pro 10 and the 2nd Huawei pro 30 
And i have the following problems 
The capture rate is low with alot of disconnections although iam using the native algorithm 
The  2nd problem is that the Huawei pro 30 is not connected although its added as a follower in the watch
Any suggestions 
Thanks

comments.body: Have you tried the latest nightly build? Have you tried to disconnect the WearOS watches?

I don't know how to set the nightly build, the watch is full android and i would like to connect it for school monitoring and when I paired it with my Huawei pro 10 it worked then I added the 2nd Huawei pro 30 for her mother but the later didn't work only mine worked

@drgymnast Would you please close this issue if it has been addressed?
If not, could you please post in the xDrip support group on facebook?
https://www.facebook.com/groups/xDripG5
Or in the Gitter room.  https://gitter.im/jamorham/xDrip-plus
Thanks
